name: Soul Shattering Star: Starset Prism
source:
This is the story of an unlikely binary star, the tale of a vollaivin and shapeshifter enjoying a rare time of peace, not knowing that their path will soon approach the farthest point of their orbits. 

Before the violent fallout, there were just two best friends on the verge of something more, learning about each other and their cultures through the art of perfume making.

[From [url=https://atelierursine.itch.io/soul-shattering-star-starset-prism]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个不太可能的双星的故事，一个沃莱文和变形者享受难得的和平时光的故事，不知道他们的路径很快就会接近轨道的最远点。

在暴力事件发生之前，只有两个最好的朋友正处于更多事情的边缘，通过香水制作艺术了解彼此和他们的文化。

[来自[url=https://atelierursine.itch.io/soul-shattering-star-starset-prism]itch.io[/url]]
